title: Credit card points free kyun milte hain?
topic: Credit card reward points: merchant fee (MDR) and interchange fund the rewards, and why banks are trimming them
world: Card swipe = a bill slice cut at the counter
caption:
Credit card swipe pe 5X points kaise milte hain, bank free mein kyun deta hai? Credit card reward points explained in Hindi.

Comment CARDMATHS, points ka maths cheat sheet DM mein bhejta hoon.

Us dost ko bhejo jo points ke chakkar mein extra kharcha karta hai.

Swipe ke baad dukaandaar ko poora paisa nahi milta: usse merchant fee (MDR) kategi, jisme bank ka interchange hissa hota hai. Credit card pe yeh fee lagbhag 1% se 3% tak hoti hai. Aam taur pe rewards isi fee se nikalte hain.
Banks ab profitability dekh rahe hain: HDFC Regalia Gold pe 15 May 2026 se 4 points per Rs 150 ki jagah 5 points per Rs 200.

Yeh explainer hai, financial ya investment advice nahi. Save karo, kaam aayega.
